obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic cinematic night photograph on a flooded last-train subway platform that opens into a moonlit reed river. An unmistakably adult woman serves as a Korean afterlife guide. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and understated natural styling follow the reference portrait. She carries a closed destination ledger against her chest and walks shoulder to shoulder with one translucent deceased traveler. The guide opens a luminous threshold door with her free hand and the traveler follows her gesture across it. One wet footprint changes into reflected starlight at the boundary, making the handoff visible. Show the guide, traveler, ledger, threshold, and transformed footprint in one coherent full-body composition, with contemporary dark layered clothing, rain reflections, and restrained moonlight.

bindings.guide_role_phrase: An adult serves as a Korean afterlife guide
bindings.deceased_traveler_phrase: one translucent deceased traveler remains beside the guide
bindings.escort_action_phrase: the guide opens the threshold and the traveler follows her across the luminous passage
bindings.threshold_handoff_phrase: a transformed footprint marks passage across the boundary
bindings.culture_boundary_phrase: an original contemporary Korean visual mechanism carries the role
